name: Macksteel Warehouse, Inc
old_description: Below are just a few of our capabilities and manufacturing processes that we use to set ourselves apart
about:
Macksteel Warehouse, Inc. is based in Watertown, South Dakota. The company traces its roots to 1973 when Steve and Beverly Mack started a portable baling business processing scrap metals across the region. A few years later they purchased the current property and formed Mack Wrecking, Inc. as a scrap iron and metal recycler. In 1998 the scrap division was sold and the name changed to Macksteel Warehouse, Inc., shifting focus to metal service center operations and adding fabrication equipment to produce finished parts.

Today the company operates nearly 145,000 square feet of space and maintains one of the largest inventories of structural steel in the area, including tube, channel, beam, flat bar, and rod, plus over 5,000 sheets of aluminum, stainless, and carbon steel. Its fabrication capabilities cover metal cutting from 24-gauge up to 3-inch thickness, precision bending driven by modern software, and wire and tube forming. The shop also offers reverse engineering from templates, prints, or scrap parts, and supports product development and prototyping.

Macksteel serves industrial and commercial customers throughout the region who need a combination of raw material supply, custom fabrication, and finished-part manufacturing. The company’s integrated model allows clients to source stock, have it cut and formed, and receive completed assemblies without changing vendors.

The business emphasizes its unified approach — distribution, fabrication, and manufacturing under one roof — as a key differentiator. It also promotes same-day pickup for most orders, a broad in-stock selection, and equipment capable of tight bending tolerances.
